propos: Each measure is drawn here at its real size, not just written. Values come from the Night mock-up.
cadre-note: The frame height is drawn as a length: 844 px do not fit on a screen. The strip scrolls on its own; the page never does.
composants-note: Each square carries the measurement on both sides, even when the token only applies to a width or a height.

propos-groupe.espacements: Screen margin 20; between blocks 22 on the home screen, 18 on sessions, 20 in the glossary.
propos-groupe.cibles: 44 px for a round button and a day pill, 52 for the primary button, 56 for a field and a row.
propos-groupe.rayons: 24 block · 22 round button · 20 timeline card · 18 field · 16 button and card row · 14 and 12 icon chips · 6 “EN” tag and track · pill for days and tags.
propos-groupe.filets: A 1 px rule separates; colour, not thickness, carries importance. The focus ring is 3 px, 2 px away from its target.
propos-groupe.zones: What the status bar, the tab bar and the system gesture take from the screen.
propos-groupe.cadre: Reference frame 390 × 844. Nothing has a fixed width except the time column.
propos-groupe.composants: The dimensions a component does not choose for itself.
